questions.question: What was the life expectancy at birth for the total United States population in 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_us_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0] == '0-1'].index[0]
result = float(df.loc[start_idx, 6])

questions.question: At what age interval did the number of deaths reach its highest point in the 2024 United States life table?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_us_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0] == '0-1'].index[0]
end_idx = df[df[0] == '100 and over'].index[0]
data = df.loc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
data[3] = pd.to_numeric(data[3])
result = str(data.loc[data[3].idxmax(), 0])

questions.question: Based on the 2024 United States life table, does more than half of the initial population survive to reach age 80?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_us_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0] == '0-1'].index[0]
end_idx = df[df[0] == '100 and over'].index[0]
data = df.loc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
data[2] = pd.to_numeric(data[2])
surviving_80 = data.loc[data[0] == '80-81', 2].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if surviving_80 > 50000 else 'no'

questions.question: For how many age intervals in 2024 was the probability of dying within one year strictly below 0.001?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_us_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0] == '0-1'].index[0]
end_idx = df[df[0] == '100 and over'].index[0]
data = df.loc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
data[1] = pd.to_numeric(data[1])
result = int((data[1] < 0.001).sum())

questions.question: Which three single-year age brackets had the lowest annual mortality probabilities in the 2024 life table?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_us_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0] == '0-1'].index[0]
end_idx = df[df[0] == '100 and over'].index[0]

questions.question: What is the difference in remaining life expectancy between an individual reaching age 65 and one reaching age 85 in the 2024 United States life table?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_nvsr_us_life_table.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0] == '0-1'].index[0]
end_idx = df[df[0] == '100 and over'].index[0]
data = df.loc[start_idx:end_idx].copy()
data[6] = pd.to_numeric(data[6])
ex_65 = data.loc[data[0] == '65-66', 6].iloc[0]
ex_85 = data.loc[data[0] == '85-86', 6].iloc[0]
result = float(ex_65 - ex_85)
